SELECT a1.campaign_id,
    sp_campaign_reports."campaignName",
    a1.time_window_start,
    a1.ad_group_id,
    a1.keyword_id,
    a1.ad_id,
    a1.keyword_text,
    a1.match_type,
    a1.placement,
    a1.clicks,
    a1.impressions,
    a1.cost,
    timezone('UTC'::text, timezone('PDT'::text, a1.time_window_start)) AS pdt_timestamp,
    timezone('UTC'::text, timezone('US/Eastern'::text, a1.time_window_start)) AS edt_timestamp,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_conversions_1d, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_conversions_1d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_conversions_7d, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_conversions_7d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_conversions_14d, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_conversions_14d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_conversions_30d, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_conversions_30d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_sales_1d, (0)::double precision) AS attributed_sales_1d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_sales_7d, (0)::double precision) AS attributed_sales_7d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_sales_14d, (0)::double precision) AS attributed_sales_14d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_sales_30d, (0)::double precision) AS attributed_sales_30d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_units_ordered_1d, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_units_ordered_1d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_units_ordered_7d, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_units_ordered_7d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_units_ordered_14d, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_units_ordered_14d,
    COALESCE(a2.attributed_units_ordered_30d, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_units_ordered_30d,
    ((a1.clicks)::double precision /
        CASE
            WHEN (a1.impressions = (0)::numeric) THEN (0.00001)::double precision
            ELSE COALESCE((a1.impressions)::double precision, (0.00001)::double precision)
        END) AS ctr,
    (a1.cost /
        CASE
            WHEN (a1.clicks = (0)::numeric) THEN (0.00001)::double precision
            ELSE COALESCE((a1.clicks)::double precision, (0.00001)::double precision)
        END) AS cpc,
    (a1.cost / COALESCE(a2.attributed_sales_1d, (0.00001)::double precision)) AS acos,
    ((COALESCE(a2.attributed_conversions_1d, (0)::numeric))::double precision /
        CASE
            WHEN (a1.clicks = (0)::numeric) THEN (0.00001)::double precision
            ELSE COALESCE((a1.clicks)::double precision, (0.00001)::double precision)
        END) AS cvr,
    sp_targeting_reports.portfolio_id,
    pin.portfolio_name,
    pin.product_line,
    abu.budget,
    pin.keyword_match
   FROM (((((( SELECT sp_traffic.campaign_id,
            sp_traffic.time_window_start,
            sum(sp_traffic.clicks) AS clicks,
            sum(sp_traffic.impressions) AS impressions,
            sum(sp_traffic.cost) AS cost,
            min(sp_traffic.placement) AS placement,
            sp_traffic.ad_group_id,
            sp_traffic.keyword_id,
            sp_traffic.keyword_text,
            sp_traffic.match_type,
            sp_traffic.ad_id
           FROM datas.sp_traffic
          WHERE ((sp_traffic.time_window_start >= (((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - '24:00:00'::interval) - ((date_part('minutes'::text, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) || ' min'::text))::interval) - ((date_part('seconds'::text, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) || ' sec'::text))::interval)) AND (sp_traffic.time_window_start < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - '00:00:00'::interval)))
          GROUP BY sp_traffic.campaign_id, sp_traffic.time_window_start, sp_traffic.placement, sp_traffic.ad_group_id, sp_traffic.keyword_id, sp_traffic.ad_id, sp_traffic.keyword_text, sp_traffic.match_type) a1
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ads_budget_usage.budget_scope_id,
            max(ads_budget_usage.usage_updated_timestamp) AS latest_date,
            ads_budget_usage.budget
           FROM datas.ads_budget_usage
          GROUP BY ads_budget_usage.budget_scope_id, ads_budget_usage.budget) abu ON ((abu.budget_scope_id = a1.campaign_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sp_conversion.campaign_id,
            sp_conversion.time_window_start,
            min(sp_conversion.placement) AS placement,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_conversions_1d) AS attributed_conversions_1d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_conversions_7d) AS attributed_conversions_7d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_conversions_14d) AS attributed_conversions_14d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_conversions_30d) AS attributed_conversions_30d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_sales_1d) AS attributed_sales_1d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_sales_7d) AS attributed_sales_7d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_sales_14d) AS attributed_sales_14d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_sales_30d) AS attributed_sales_30d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_units_ordered_1d) AS attributed_units_ordered_1d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_units_ordered_7d) AS attributed_units_ordered_7d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_units_ordered_14d) AS attributed_units_ordered_14d,
            sum(sp_conversion.attributed_units_ordered_30d) AS attributed_units_ordered_30d,
            sp_conversion.ad_group_id,
            sp_conversion.keyword_id,
            sp_conversion.ad_id
           FROM datas.sp_conversion
          GROUP BY sp_conversion.campaign_id, sp_conversion.time_window_start, sp_conversion.placement, sp_conversion.ad_group_id, sp_conversion.keyword_id, sp_conversion.ad_id) a2 ON (((a1.campaign_id = a2.campaign_id) AND (a1.time_window_start = a2.time_window_start) AND (a1.placement = a2.placement) AND (a1.ad_group_id = a2.ad_group_id) AND (a1.keyword_id = a2.keyword_id) AND (a1.ad_id = a2.ad_id))))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT min(sp_campaign_reports_1."campaignName") AS "campaignName",
            sp_campaign_reports_1."campaignId"
           FROM datas.sp_campaign_reports sp_campaign_reports_1
          GROUP BY sp_campaign_reports_1."campaignId") sp_campaign_reports ON ((a1.campaign_id = sp_campaign_reports."campaignId")))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT min(sp_targeting_reports_1."portfolioId") AS portfolio_id,
            sp_targeting_reports_1."campaignId"
           FROM datas.sp_targeting_reports sp_targeting_reports_1
          GROUP BY sp_targeting_reports_1."campaignId") sp_targeting_reports ON ((a1.campaign_id = sp_targeting_reports."campaignId")))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT portfolio_id_name.portfolio_id,
            portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name,
            portfolio_id_name.product_line,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%gaming%'::text) THEN 'gaming'::text
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%commericial%'::text) THEN 'commericial'::text
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%entry%'::text) THEN 'entry'::text
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%premium%'::text) THEN 'premium'::text
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%aio%'::text) THEN 'aio'::text
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%adata%'::text) THEN 'adata'::text
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%solidigm%'::text) THEN 'solidigm'::text
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%p22va%'::text) THEN 'p22va'::text
                    WHEN (lower((portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name)::text) ~~ '%offensive%'::text) THEN 'offensive'::text
                    ELSE 'other'::text
                END AS keyword_match
           FROM datas.portfolio_id_name) pin ON ((pin.portfolio_id = sp_targeting_reports.portfolio_id)));

SELECT DISTINCT campaign_name,
    product_line
   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT budget_usage.campaign_name,
            budget_usage.product_line
           FROM budget_usage
        UNION ALL
         SELECT DISTINCT ad_info_summary.campaign_name,
            ad_info_summary.product_line
           FROM ad_info_summary) a;

WITH recentdata AS (
         SELECT ad_info_summary.keyword_id,
            ad_info_summary.product_line,
            ad_info_summary.campaign_name,
            sum(ad_info_summary.clicks) AS clicks,
            sum(ad_info_summary.impressions) AS impressions,
            sum(ad_info_summary.cost) AS cost,
            sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_conversions_1d) AS orders,
            sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_sales_1d) AS sales,
                CASE
                    WHEN (sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_sales_1d) <= (0)::double precision) THEN (0)::double precision
                    ELSE (sum(ad_info_summary.cost) / sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_sales_1d))
                END AS acos,
            ad_info_summary.keyword_text,
            ad_info_summary.match_type
           FROM ad_info_summary
          WHERE (ad_info_summary.edt_timestamp >= (timezone('US/Eastern'::text, timezone('US/Eastern'::text, (CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone)) + '03:00:00'::interval))
          GROUP BY ad_info_summary.keyword_id, ad_info_summary.product_line, ad_info_summary.campaign_name, ad_info_summary.keyword_text, ad_info_summary.match_type
        ), percentiles AS (
         SELECT recentdata.product_line,
            percentile_cont((0.90)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((
                CASE
                    WHEN (recentdata.orders = (1)::numeric) THEN recentdata.clicks
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END)::double precision)) AS click_90th,
            percentile_cont((0.90)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN (recentdata.orders <> (0)::numeric) THEN recentdata.acos
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END) AS acos_90th
           FROM recentdata
          GROUP BY recentdata.product_line
        )
 SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'PST'::text) AS updated_time,
    ais.keyword_id,
    ais.product_line,
    ais.campaign_name,
    ais.clicks,
    ais.impressions,
    ais.cost,
    ais.orders,
    ais.sales,
    ais.acos,
    ais.keyword_text,
    ais.match_type,
        CASE
            WHEN (((ais.clicks)::double precision > p.click_90th) AND (ais.orders = (0)::numeric)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS click_high,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ais.acos > p.acos_90th) AND (ais.orders <> (0)::numeric)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS acos_high
   FROM (recentdata ais
     JOIN percentiles p ON (((ais.product_line)::text = (p.product_line)::text)));

WITH ad_ad_id_sku AS (
         SELECT sp_advertised_product_reports."adId" AS ad_id,
            sp_advertised_product_reports."advertisedSku" AS sku
           FROM datas.sp_advertised_product_reports
          WHERE (sp_advertised_product_reports."advertisedSku" IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY sp_advertised_product_reports."adId", sp_advertised_product_reports."advertisedSku"
        ), ad_info AS (
         SELECT ad_info_summary.ad_id,
            ad_info_summary.product_line,
            ad_info_summary.campaign_name,
            sum(ad_info_summary.clicks) AS clicks,
            sum(ad_info_summary.impressions) AS impressions,
            sum(ad_info_summary.cost) AS cost,
            sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_conversions_1d) AS orders,
            sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_sales_1d) AS sales,
                CASE
                    WHEN (sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_sales_1d) <= (0)::double precision) THEN (0)::double precision
                    ELSE (sum(ad_info_summary.cost) / sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_sales_1d))
                END AS acos
           FROM ad_info_summary
          WHERE (ad_info_summary.edt_timestamp >= (timezone('US/Eastern'::text, timezone('US/Eastern'::text, (CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone)) + '03:00:00'::interval))
          GROUP BY ad_info_summary.ad_id, ad_info_summary.product_line, ad_info_summary.campaign_name
        ), ais AS (
         SELECT ad_info.ad_id,
            ad_info.product_line,
            ad_info.campaign_name,
            ad_info.clicks,
            ad_info.impressions,
            ad_info.cost,
            ad_info.orders,
            ad_info.sales,
            ad_info.acos,
            ad_ad_id_sku.sku
           FROM (ad_info
             LEFT JOIN ad_ad_id_sku ON ((ad_info.ad_id = ad_ad_id_sku.ad_id)))
        ), product_line_percentiles AS (
         SELECT ais_1.product_line,
            percentile_cont((0.90)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((
                CASE
                    WHEN (ais_1.orders = (1)::numeric) THEN ais_1.clicks
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END)::double precision)) AS click_90th,
            percentile_cont((0.90)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN (ais_1.orders <> (0)::numeric) THEN ais_1.acos
                    ELSE NULL::double precision
                END) AS acos_90th
           FROM ais ais_1
          GROUP BY ais_1.product_line
        )
 SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'PST'::text) AS updated_time,
    ais.ad_id,
    ais.product_line,
    ais.campaign_name,
    ais.clicks,
    ais.impressions,
    ais.cost,
    ais.orders,
    ais.sales,
    ais.acos,
    ais.sku,
        CASE
            WHEN (((ais.clicks)::double precision > plp.click_90th) AND (ais.orders = (0)::numeric)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS click_high,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ais.acos > plp.acos_90th) AND (ais.orders <> (0)::numeric)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS acos_high
   FROM (ais
     JOIN product_line_percentiles plp ON (((ais.product_line)::text = (plp.product_line)::text)));

WITH pl_threshold AS (
         SELECT al.product_line,
            al.portfolio_name,
            al.portfolio_id,
            al.dm,
                CASE
                    WHEN (sum(al.sales7d) <= (0)::numeric) THEN (0)::numeric
                    ELSE COALESCE((sum(al.cost) / sum(al.sales7d)), (0)::numeric)
                END AS acos,
            percentile_cont((0.95)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((al.clicks)::double precision)) AS percentile_95
           FROM ( SELECT apr.purchases7d,
                    pin.portfolio_id,
                    apr."searchTerm",
                    (sum(apr.clicks) / sum(apr.purchases7d)) AS clicks,
                    apr.sales7d,
                    apr.cost,
                    pin.portfolio_name,
                    pin.product_line,
                    pin.dm
                   FROM (( SELECT sum(sp_search_term_reports.purchases7d) AS purchases7d,
                            sum(sp_search_term_reports.sales7d) AS sales7d,
                            sum(sp_search_term_reports.cost) AS cost,
                            sp_search_term_reports."portfolioId",
                            sp_search_term_reports."searchTerm",
                            sum(sp_search_term_reports.clicks) AS clicks
                           FROM datas.sp_search_term_reports
                          WHERE ((sp_search_term_reports.clicks > 0) AND ((sp_search_term_reports.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '14 days'::interval)) AND (sp_search_term_reports.date <= CURRENT_DATE)))
                          GROUP BY sp_search_term_reports."searchTerm", sp_search_term_reports."portfolioId") apr
                     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT portfolio_id_name.portfolio_id,
                            portfolio_id_name.portfolio_name,
                            portfolio_id_name.product_line,
                            portfolio_id_name.dm
                           FROM datas.portfolio_id_name) pin ON ((pin.portfolio_id = apr."portfolioId")))
                  WHERE (apr.purchases7d >= 1)
                  GROUP BY apr.purchases7d, pin.portfolio_id, apr."searchTerm", apr.sales7d, apr.cost, pin.portfolio_name, pin.product_line, pin.dm) al
          GROUP BY al.product_line, al.portfolio_name, al.portfolio_id, al.dm
        ), campaign_14d AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT a_1."campaignId",
            b_1."campaignStatus"
           FROM (( SELECT scr."campaignId"
                   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT sp_campaign_reports."campaignId",
                            min(sp_campaign_reports.date) AS date
                           FROM datas.sp_campaign_reports
                          GROUP BY sp_campaign_reports."campaignId") scr
                  WHERE (scr.date < (CURRENT_DATE - '14 days'::interval))) a_1
             JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT sp_campaign_reports."campaignId",
                    sp_campaign_reports."campaignStatus"
                   FROM datas.sp_campaign_reports
                  WHERE (sp_campaign_reports.date = date(((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'US/Pacific'::text) - '1 day'::interval)))) b_1 ON ((a_1."campaignId" = b_1."campaignId")))
        ), st_click_no_order AS (
         SELECT sp_search_term_reports."searchTerm" AS search_term,
            sp_search_term_reports."portfolioId" AS portfolio_id,
            sp_search_term_reports."campaignName" AS campaign,
            sp_search_term_reports."adGroupName" AS adgroup,
            sum(sp_search_term_reports.cost) AS cost,
            sum(sp_search_term_reports.clicks) AS clicks,
            sum(sp_search_term_reports.purchases7d) AS purchase7d
           FROM datas.sp_search_term_reports
          WHERE ((sp_search_term_reports.clicks > 0) AND (sp_search_term_reports."campaignId" IN ( SELECT campaign_14d."campaignId"
                   FROM campaign_14d)) AND ((sp_search_term_reports.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '14 days'::interval)) AND (sp_search_term_reports.date <= CURRENT_DATE)))
          GROUP BY sp_search_term_reports."searchTerm", sp_search_term_reports."portfolioId", sp_search_term_reports."campaignName", sp_search_term_reports."adGroupName"
        ), st_has_order AS (
         SELECT sho.search_term,
            sho.portfolio_id,
            sho.campaign,
            sho.adgroup,
            sho."campaignId",
            sho.cost,
            sho.clicks,
            sho.purchases14d,
            sho.sales,
            (sho.cost / sho.sales) AS acos
           FROM ( SELECT sp_search_term_reports."searchTerm" AS search_term,
                    sp_search_term_reports."portfolioId" AS portfolio_id,
                    sp_search_term_reports."campaignName" AS campaign,
                    sp_search_term_reports."adGroupName" AS adgroup,
                    sp_search_term_reports."campaignId",
                    sum(sp_search_term_reports.cost) AS cost,
                    sum(sp_search_term_reports.clicks) AS clicks,
                    sum(sp_search_term_reports.purchases14d) AS purchases14d,
                    sum(sp_search_term_reports.sales14d) AS sales
                   FROM datas.sp_search_term_reports
                  WHERE ((sp_search_term_reports."campaignId" IN ( SELECT campaign_14d."campaignId"
                           FROM campaign_14d)) AND (sp_search_term_reports.clicks >= 1) AND ((sp_search_term_reports.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '14 days'::interval)) AND (sp_search_term_reports.date <= CURRENT_DATE)))
                  GROUP BY sp_search_term_reports."searchTerm", sp_search_term_reports."portfolioId", sp_search_term_reports."campaignName", sp_search_term_reports."adGroupName", sp_search_term_reports."campaignId") sho
          WHERE (sho.sales > (0)::numeric)
        ), st_has_order_threshold AS (
         SELECT ac.portfolio_id,
            percentile_cont((0.99)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((ac.acos)::double precision)) AS acos_percentile_99,
            percentile_cont((0.99)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((ac.purchases14d)::double precision)) AS purchases14d_percentile_99
           FROM st_has_order ac
          GROUP BY ac.portfolio_id
        ), low_effe_st_has_order AS (
         SELECT a_1.search_term,
            a_1.campaign,
            a_1.adgroup,
            b_1.portfolio_name,
            b_1.product_line,
            b_1.dm,
            a_1.cost,
            a_1.purchases14d,
            a_1.acos,
            c.acos_percentile_99 AS acos_threshold,
            c.purchases14d_percentile_99 AS purchases_threshold
           FROM ((st_has_order a_1
             LEFT JOIN datas.portfolio_id_name b_1 ON ((a_1.portfolio_id = b_1.portfolio_id)))
             LEFT JOIN st_has_order_threshold c ON ((a_1.portfolio_id = c.portfolio_id)))
          WHERE (((a_1.acos)::double precision >= c.acos_percentile_99) AND ((a_1.purchases14d)::double precision < c.purchases14d_percentile_99))
        ), low_effe_st_no_order AS (
         SELECT a_1.search_term,
            a_1.campaign,
            a_1.adgroup,
            b_1.portfolio_name,
            b_1.product_line,
            b_1.dm,
            a_1.cost,
            a_1.clicks,
            b_1.percentile_95 AS clicks_threshold_95
           FROM (pl_threshold b_1
             LEFT JOIN st_click_no_order a_1 ON ((a_1.portfolio_id = b_1.portfolio_id)))
          WHERE (((a_1.clicks)::double precision >= b_1.percentile_95) AND (a_1.purchase7d < 1))
        ), campaign_acos AS (
         SELECT scr."campaignId",
            scr."campaignName",
            a_1."campaignStatus",
                CASE
                    WHEN (sum(scr.sales14d) > (0)::numeric) THEN (sum(scr.cost) / sum(scr.sales14d))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS campaign_acos
           FROM (campaign_14d a_1
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sp_campaign_reports."campaignId",
                    sp_campaign_reports."campaignName",
                    sp_campaign_reports.sales14d,
                    sp_campaign_reports.cost
                   FROM datas.sp_campaign_reports
                  WHERE ((sp_campaign_reports.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '14 days'::interval)) AND (sp_campaign_reports.date <= CURRENT_DATE))) scr ON ((a_1."campaignId" = scr."campaignId")))
          GROUP BY scr."campaignId", scr."campaignName", a_1."campaignStatus"
        )
 SELECT a.search_term,
    a.campaign,
    a.adgroup,
    a.portfolio_name,
    a.product_line,
    a.dm,
    a.cost,
    a.purchases14d,
    a.acos,
    a.acos_threshold,
    a.purchases_threshold,
    a.clicks,
    a.clicks_threshold_95,
    b.campaign_acos,
    b."campaignStatus"
   FROM (( SELECT low_effe_st_has_order.search_term,
            low_effe_st_has_order.campaign,
            low_effe_st_has_order.adgroup,
            low_effe_st_has_order.portfolio_name,
            low_effe_st_has_order.product_line,
            low_effe_st_has_order.dm,
            low_effe_st_has_order.cost,
            low_effe_st_has_order.purchases14d,
            low_effe_st_has_order.acos,
            low_effe_st_has_order.acos_threshold,
            low_effe_st_has_order.purchases_threshold,
            0 AS clicks,
            0 AS clicks_threshold_95
           FROM low_effe_st_has_order
        UNION
         SELECT low_effe_st_no_order.search_term,
            low_effe_st_no_order.campaign,
            low_effe_st_no_order.adgroup,
            low_effe_st_no_order.portfolio_name,
            low_effe_st_no_order.product_line,
            low_effe_st_no_order.dm,
            low_effe_st_no_order.cost,
            0 AS purchases14d,
            0 AS acos,
            0 AS acos_threshold,
            0 AS purchases_threshold,
            low_effe_st_no_order.clicks,
            low_effe_st_no_order.clicks_threshold_95
           FROM low_effe_st_no_order) a
     LEFT JOIN campaign_acos b ON ((a.campaign = b."campaignName")));

SELECT ad_date,
    main_ir,
    ir,
    upc,
    sku,
    sum(spend) AS ad_spend,
    bundle_sku_id
   FROM ( SELECT aps.product_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN (bspp.bundle_sku IS NOT NULL) THEN bspp.bundle_sku_primary_main_ir
                    ELSE COALESCE(main_pp.default_code, pp.default_code)
                END AS main_ir,
                CASE
                    WHEN (bspp.bundle_sku IS NOT NULL) THEN bspp.bundle_sku_primary_ir
                    ELSE pp.default_code
                END AS ir,
            pp.barcode AS upc,
            ad.ad_date,
            ad.sku,
            ad.spend,
            bspp.bundle_sku_id
           FROM ((((( SELECT amazon_sponsored_display_advertised_product.ad_date,
                    amazon_sponsored_display_advertised_product.sku,
                    amazon_sponsored_display_advertised_product.spend
                   FROM amazon_sponsored_display_advertised_product
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT amazon_sponsored_products_advertised_product.ad_date,
                    amazon_sponsored_products_advertised_product.sku,

WITH shipping_invoice_all AS (
         SELECT sum(shipping_cost.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee,
            so.id AS order_id,
            max(so.order_unit) AS order_unit,
            max(so.date_order) AS order_date
           FROM ((( SELECT sif.express_or_ground_tracking_id AS tracking_id,
                    sum(sif.net_charge_amount) AS shipping_fee
                   FROM datas.shipping_invoice_fedex sif
                  GROUP BY sif.express_or_ground_tracking_id
                UNION
                 SELECT siu.track_num AS tracking_id,
                    sum(siu.tot_net) AS shipping_fee
                   FROM datas.shipping_invoice_ups siu
                  GROUP BY siu.track_num
                UNION
                 SELECT sb.tracking_id,
                    (COALESCE(sb.shipping, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(sa.adjustment_shipping, (0)::numeric)) AS shipping_fee
                   FROM (( SELECT shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping.tracking_id,
                            sum((shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping.tax_inclusive_total_charge_usd)::numeric) AS shipping
                           FROM datas.shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping
                          GROUP BY shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping.tracking_id) sb
                     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments.tracking_id,
                            sum((shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments.base_rate_incl_tax_usd)::numeric) AS adjustment_shipping
                           FROM datas.shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments
                          GROUP BY shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments.tracking_id) sa ON (((sb.tracking_id)::text = (sa.tracking_id)::text)))) shipping_cost
             LEFT JOIN sale_order_package sop ON (((shipping_cost.tracking_id)::text = (sop.tracking_id)::text)))
             LEFT JOIN sale_order so ON ((sop.order_id = so.id)))
          GROUP BY so.id
        ), real_shipping_fee AS (
         SELECT sol.id AS sale_order_line_id,
            sol.product_uom_qty AS order_line_unit,
            (((sol.product_uom_qty)::double precision / invoice.order_unit) * (invoice.shipping_fee)::double precision) AS order_line_total_shipping_fee,
            invoice.order_id,
            invoice.order_unit,
            invoice.shipping_fee AS order_total_shipping_fee,
            invoice.order_date,
            sol.product_id
           FROM (shipping_invoice_all invoice
             LEFT JOIN sale_order_line sol ON ((invoice.order_id = sol.order_id)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT sol.id AS sale_order_line_id,
            sol.product_uom_qty AS order_line_unit,
            (sol.per_unit_fulfillment_fee * (sol.product_uom_qty)::double precision) AS order_line_total_shipping_fee,
            so.id AS order_id,
            so.order_unit,
            NULL::numeric AS order_total_shipping_fee,
            so.date_order AS order_date,
            sol.product_id
           FROM ((sale_order_line sol
             LEFT JOIN sale_order so ON ((sol.order_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_product p ON ((sol.product_id = p.id)))
          WHERE ((so.amz_fulfillment_by)::text = 'AFN'::text)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT sol.id AS sale_order_line_id,
            sol.product_uom_qty AS order_line_unit,
            ((abs(sri.other_amount) / so.order_unit) * (sol.product_uom_qty)::double precision) AS order_line_total_shipping_fee,
            so.id AS order_id,
            so.order_unit,
            abs(sri.other_amount) AS order_total_shipping_fee,
            so.date_order AS order_date,
            sol.product_id
           FROM (((( SELECT settlement_report_info.order_id,
                    sum(settlement_report_info.other_amount) AS other_amount
                   FROM settlement_report_info
                  WHERE ((settlement_report_info.transaction_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY['Shipping label purchase'::text, 'ShippingServicesRefund'::text]))
                  GROUP BY settlement_report_info.order_id) sri
             JOIN sale_order so ON (((sri.order_id)::text = (so.name)::text)))
             LEFT JOIN sale_order_line sol ON ((sol.order_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_product p ON ((sol.product_id = p.id)))
          WHERE (sri.other_amount <> (0)::double precision)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT sol.id AS sale_order_line_id,
            sol.product_uom_qty AS order_line_unit,
            (((abs(t.total))::double precision / so.order_unit) * (sol.product_uom_qty)::double precision) AS order_line_total_shipping_fee,
            so.id AS order_id,
            so.order_unit,
            abs(t.total) AS order_total_shipping_fee,
            so.date_order AS order_date,
            sol.product_id
           FROM (((( SELECT t_1.order_id,
                    sum(abs((t_1.total)::numeric)) AS total
                   FROM datas.shipping_invoice_temu t_1
                  WHERE ((t_1.transaction_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('Shipping label for return purchase'::character varying)::text, ('Shipping label for return purchase adjustment'::character varying)::text, ('Shipping label purchase'::character varying)::text, ('Shipping label purchase adjustment'::character varying)::text]))
                  GROUP BY t_1.order_id) t
             JOIN sale_order so ON (((t.order_id)::text = (so.name)::text)))
             LEFT JOIN sale_order_line sol ON ((sol.order_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_product p ON ((sol.product_id = p.id)))
        ), order_line_shipping_fee AS (
         SELECT r.sale_order_line_id,
            r.order_line_unit,
            r.order_line_total_shipping_fee,
            r.order_id,
            r.order_unit,
            r.order_total_shipping_fee,
            r.order_date,
            r.product_id,
            p.default_code AS product_ir
           FROM (real_shipping_fee r
             LEFT JOIN product_product p ON ((r.product_id = p.id)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT sol.id AS sale_order_line_id,
            sol.product_uom_qty AS order_line_unit,
            ((abs(sop.estimate_shipping_fee) / so.order_unit) * (sol.product_uom_qty)::double precision) AS order_line_total_shipping_fee,
            sop.order_id,
            so.order_unit,
            abs(sop.estimate_shipping_fee) AS order_total_shipping_fee,
            so.date_order AS order_date,
            sol.product_id,
            p.default_code AS product_ir
           FROM ((((sale_order_line sol
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sale_order_package.order_id,
                    sum(abs(sale_order_package.estimate_shipping_fee)) AS estimate_shipping_fee
                   FROM sale_order_package
                  WHERE (sale_order_package.estimate_shipping_fee IS NOT NULL)
                  GROUP BY sale_order_package.order_id) sop ON ((sol.order_id = sop.order_id)))
             LEFT JOIN sale_order so ON ((sol.order_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN real_shipping_fee r ON ((sol.id = r.sale_order_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_product p ON ((sol.product_id = p.id)))
          WHERE ((r.sale_order_line_id IS NULL) AND (sop.estimate_shipping_fee IS NOT NULL))
        )
 SELECT sale_order_line_id,
    product_ir,
    order_line_unit,
    order_line_total_shipping_fee,
    order_id,
    order_unit,
    (order_total_shipping_fee)::numeric AS order_total_shipping_fee,
    order_date
   FROM order_line_shipping_fee;

        ), productsales AS (
         SELECT main_pp.id AS main_product_id,

                   FROM ba_mv_sync_inventory_report))

         SELECT pp_1.id AS main_product_id,
            pp_1.last_days_sale_5,

           FROM product_product pp_1
          WHERE ((pp_1.main_product_id IS NULL) AND ((pp_1.default_code)::text IN ( SELECT ba_mv_sync_inventory_report.default_code
                   FROM ba_mv_sync_inventory_report)))
        ), main_sale_qty AS (
         SELECT productsales.origin_ir,
            sum(productsales.last_days_sale_5) AS total_last_days_sales
           FROM productsales
          GROUP BY productsales.origin_ir
        ), latestmanualmos AS (
         SELECT mrp_production.product_id,
            mrp_production.date_finished,

        ), last_production_date AS (
         SELECT pp_1.default_code,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lm.row_num IS NOT NULL) THEN to_char(timezone('US/Eastern'::text, (lm.date_finished AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)), 'MM/DD/YYYY'::text)
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS last_manual_mo_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lm.row_num IS NOT NULL) THEN lm.product_qty
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS last_mo_qty
           FROM ((( SELECT DISTINCT mrp_production.product_id
                   FROM mrp_production) p
             LEFT JOIN latestmanualmos lm ON (((p.product_id = lm.product_id) AND (lm.row_num = 1))))
             LEFT JOIN product_product pp_1 ON ((p.product_id = pp_1.id)))
        ), latestsos AS (
         SELECT sol.product_id,
            so.date_order,
            sol.sku,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sol.product_id ORDER BY so.date_order DESC) AS row_num
           FROM (sale_order so
             LEFT JOIN sale_order_line sol ON ((so.id = sol.order_id)))
          WHERE (((so.oos_status)::text = 'done'::text) AND (sol.qty_delivered <> (0)::numeric))
        ), last_so_date AS (
         SELECT pp_1.default_code,
            ls.sku,
                CASE
                    WHEN (ls.row_num IS NOT NULL) THEN to_char(timezone('US/Eastern'::text, (ls.date_order AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)), 'MM/DD/YYYY'::text)
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS last_order_date
           FROM ((( SELECT DISTINCT sale_order_line.product_id
                   FROM sale_order_line) p
             LEFT JOIN latestsos ls ON (((p.product_id = ls.product_id) AND (ls.row_num = 1))))
             LEFT JOIN product_product pp_1 ON ((p.product_id = pp_1.id)))
        )
 SELECT sync_in.default_code AS ir,
    sync_in.barcode,
    sync_in.follower,
    COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale_5, (0)::double precision) AS last_7d_sale,
    COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale, (0)::double precision) AS last_30d_sale,
    COALESCE(round((
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale_5, (0)::double precision) = (0)::double precision) THEN (9999)::double precision
            ELSE ((((sync_in.de_onhand + sync_in.ca_onhand) + sync_in.transit_onhand) * (7)::double precision) / COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale_5, (0)::double precision))
        END)::numeric, 2), (9999)::numeric) AS etailflow_7daydsi,
    COALESCE(round((
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale, (0)::double precision) = (0)::double precision) THEN (9999)::double precision
            ELSE ((((sync_in.de_onhand + sync_in.ca_onhand) + sync_in.transit_onhand) * (30)::double precision) / COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale, (0)::double precision))
        END)::numeric, 2), (9999)::numeric) AS etailflow_30daydsi,
    COALESCE(round((
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale_5, (0)::double precision) = (0)::double precision) THEN (9999)::double precision
            ELSE ((sync_in.total_new_inventory * (7)::double precision) / COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale_5, (0)::double precision))
        END)::numeric, 2), (9999)::numeric) AS total_7daydsi,
    COALESCE(round((
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale, (0)::double precision) = (0)::double precision) THEN (9999)::double precision
            ELSE ((sync_in.total_new_inventory * (30)::double precision) / COALESCE(pp.last_days_sale, (0)::double precision))
        END)::numeric, 2), (9999)::numeric) AS total_30daydsi,
    sync_in.total_new_inventory AS total_qty,
    sync_in.de_onhand AS de_qty,
    sync_in.ca_onhand AS ca_qty,
    sync_in.fba_onhand AS fba_qty,
    sync_in.wfs_onhand AS wfs_qty,
    sync_in.can_onhand AS can_qty,
    sync_in.canfba_onhand AS can_fba_qty,
    sync_in.transit_onhand AS transit_qty,
    COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN (pt.purchase_price > (0)::numeric) THEN ((pt.purchase_price)::double precision * sync_in.total_new_inventory)
            ELSE (ip.value_float * sync_in.total_new_inventory)
        END, (0)::double precision) AS total_value,
    sync_in2.total_new_inventory AS base_product_qty,
    COALESCE(round((
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(main_sale_qty.total_last_days_sales, (0)::double precision) = (0)::double precision) THEN (9999)::double precision
            ELSE ((main_product_qty.base_product_qty * (7)::double precision) / COALESCE(main_sale_qty.total_last_days_sales, (0)::double precision))
        END)::numeric, 2), (9999)::numeric) AS all_products_7daydsi,
    last_production_date.last_manual_mo_date AS last_mo_finish_date,
    last_production_date.last_mo_qty,
    last_so_date.last_order_date,
    last_so_date.sku AS last_order_sku
   FROM ((((((((ba_mv_sync_inventory_report sync_in
     LEFT JOIN product_template pt ON (((sync_in.default_code)::text = (pt.default_code)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN product_product pp ON ((pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ir_property.value_float,
            ir_property.res_id
           FROM ir_property
          WHERE ((ir_property.name)::text = 'standard_price'::text)) ip ON (((ip.res_id)::text = ('product.product,'::text || pp.id))))
     LEFT JOIN ba_mv_sync_inventory_report sync_in2 ON (((sync_in.origin_ir)::text = (sync_in2.default_code)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN main_product_qty ON (((main_product_qty.origin_ir)::text = (sync_in.origin_ir)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN main_sale_qty ON (((main_sale_qty.origin_ir)::text = (sync_in.origin_ir)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN last_production_date ON (((last_production_date.default_code)::text = (sync_in.default_code)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN last_so_date ON (((last_so_date.default_code)::text = (sync_in.default_code)::text)))
  WHERE ((sync_in.de_onhand <> (0)::double precision) OR (sync_in.fba_onhand <> (0)::double precision) OR (sync_in.ca_onhand <> (0)::double precision) OR (sync_in.can_onhand <> (0)::double precision) OR (sync_in.wfs_onhand <> (0)::double precision) OR (sync_in.canfba_onhand <> (0)::double precision) OR (sync_in.transit_onhand <> (0)::double precision))
  ORDER BY sync_in.total_new_inventory DESC;

WITH daily_sales AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.date_order) AS "Date",
            ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.follower,
            sum(ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.price_subtotal) AS "Sales",
            sum(ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.units) AS "Units",
            count(DISTINCT
                CASE
                    WHEN (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.type = 'order'::text) THEN ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.order_name
                    ELSE NULL::character varying
                END) AS "Order_Count",
            sum(ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.ad_spend) AS "Ads cost",
            abs(sum(ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.promotion)) AS "Promo cost",
            round((sum((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.price_subtotal - ((((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.product_cost_unit + ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.hardware_cost) - ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.removed_hardware) * (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.units)::double precision) + (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.commission)::double precision))))::numeric, 2) AS "Profit wo Ads & Promo",
            round((sum((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.price_subtotal - ((((((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.product_cost_unit + ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.hardware_cost) - ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.removed_hardware) * (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.units)::double precision) + (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.commission)::double precision) + abs(ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.promotion)) + (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.ad_spend)::double precision))))::numeric, 2) AS "Profit with Ads & Promo",
            sum(ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee
           FROM ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info
          WHERE ((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.has_product_cost = true) AND (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.has_sale_price = true) AND ((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.category)::text <> ALL (ARRAY[('BOM'::character varying)::text, ('Used'::character varying)::text, ('New'::character varying)::text, ('Services'::character varying)::text, ('Computer Accessories'::character varying)::text, ('Warranty'::character varying)::text])))
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('day'::text, ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.date_order)), ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.follower
          ORDER BY (date_trunc('day'::text, ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.date_order)) DESC

 SELECT COALESCE(ds."Date", (di."Date")::timestamp without time zone) AS "Date",

WITH walmart_data AS (
         SELECT cwzy_walmart_recon_info.purchase_order AS order_id,
            cwzy_walmart_recon_info.partner_item_id AS sku,
            abs(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (((cwzy_walmart_recon_info.amount_type)::text = 'Commission on Product'::text) AND ((cwzy_walmart_recon_info.transaction_type)::text = 'Sale'::text)) THEN (cwzy_walmart_recon_info.amount)::double precision
                    ELSE ((0)::numeric)::double precision
                END)) AS commission_fee,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (((cwzy_walmart_recon_info.amount_type)::text = 'Total Walmart Funded Savings'::text) AND ((cwzy_walmart_recon_info.transaction_type)::text = 'Sale'::text)) THEN (cwzy_walmart_recon_info.amount)::double precision
                    ELSE (0)::double precision
                END) AS "Total Walmart Funded Savings"
           FROM cwzy_walmart_recon_info
          GROUP BY cwzy_walmart_recon_info.purchase_order, cwzy_walmart_recon_info.partner_item_id
        ), newegg_data AS (
         SELECT cwzy_newegg_settlement_info."order_ID" AS order_id,
            cwzy_newegg_settlement_info.seller_part_number AS sku,
            abs(sum(cwzy_newegg_settlement_info.commission_fee)) AS commission_fee
           FROM cwzy_newegg_settlement_info
          WHERE ((cwzy_newegg_settlement_info.transaction_type)::text = 'Order'::text)
          GROUP BY cwzy_newegg_settlement_info."order_ID", cwzy_newegg_settlement_info.seller_part_number
        ), sub_product AS (
         SELECT tab_ol_1.order_name,
            tab_ol_1.sku,
            ((tab_ol_1.price_unit)::double precision - tab_ol_1.product_cost_unit) AS commission
           FROM (ba_order_line_info tab_ol_1
             LEFT JOIN cwzy_bundle_sku_lines cbsl_1 ON ((tab_ol_1.bundle_sku_line_id = cbsl_1.id)))
          WHERE ((cbsl_1.is_primary_product = false) AND ((tab_ol_1.market_place = 'Newegg'::text) OR (tab_ol_1.market_place = 'Neweggbusiness'::text) OR (tab_ol_1.market_place = 'Walmart'::text)))
        ), tab_computer_category AS (
         SELECT product_category.parent_left,
            product_category.parent_right
           FROM product_category
          WHERE ((product_category.name)::text = 'Computers'::text)
        )
 SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN (tab_ol.market_place = 'pconline'::text) THEN (tab_ol.price_subtotal * 0.04)
            ELSE (tab_ol.price_subtotal * 0.08)
        END AS operation_cost,
    tab_ol.units AS order_line_unit,
    COALESCE((sco.shipping_fee)::double precision, (0)::double precision) AS order_line_total_shipping_fee,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (cbsl.is_primary_product = false) THEN ((tab_ol.price_unit)::double precision - tab_ol.product_cost_unit)
            WHEN (tab_ol.market_place <> ALL (ARRAY['Newegg'::text, 'Neweggbusiness'::text, 'Walmart'::text])) THEN (((tab_ol.price_subtotal)::double precision - abs(COALESCE(tab_prom.promotion, (0)::double precision))) * COALESCE(bsc.commission_rate, (0)::double precision))
            WHEN (cbsl.is_primary_product IS NULL) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN (tab_ol.market_place = 'Walmart'::text) THEN COALESCE(wd.commission_fee, (((tab_ol.price_subtotal)::double precision - abs(COALESCE(tab_prom.promotion, (0)::double precision))) * COALESCE(bsc.commission_rate, (0)::double precision)))
                WHEN (tab_ol.market_place = ANY (ARRAY['Newegg'::text, 'Neweggbusiness'::text])) THEN COALESCE(nd.commission_fee, (((tab_ol.price_subtotal)::double precision - abs(COALESCE(tab_prom.promotion, (0)::double precision))) * COALESCE(bsc.commission_rate, (0)::double precision)))
                ELSE NULL::double precision
            END
            WHEN ((tab_ol.market_place = ANY (ARRAY['Newegg'::text, 'Neweggbusiness'::text, 'Walmart'::text])) AND (cbsl.is_primary_product = true)) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN ((wd.commission_fee IS NOT NULL) OR (nd.commission_fee IS NOT NULL)) THEN (COALESCE(wd.commission_fee, nd.commission_fee) - sp.commission)
                ELSE (((tab_ol.price_subtotal)::double precision - abs(COALESCE(tab_prom.promotion, (0)::double precision))) * COALESCE(bsc.commission_rate, (0)::double precision))
            END
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END)::numeric AS commission,
    COALESCE(tab_prom.promotion, (0)::double precision) AS promotion,
    tab_ol.order_line_id,
    tab_ol.market_place,
    tab_ol.account_type,
    tab_ol.store,
    tab_ol.order_name,
    tab_ol.sku,
    tab_ol.date_order,
    tab_ol.main_product_id,
    tab_ol.product_id,
    tab_ol.main_upc,
    tab_ol.main_ir,
    tab_ol.upc,
    tab_ol.ir,
    tab_ol.units,
        CASE
            WHEN (tab_ol.units <> (0)::numeric) THEN ((COALESCE((tab_ol.price_subtotal)::double precision, (0)::double precision) + COALESCE(wd."Total Walmart Funded Savings", (0)::double precision)) / (tab_ol.units)::double precision)
            ELSE (0)::double precision
        END AS price_unit,
    (COALESCE((tab_ol.price_subtotal)::double precision, (0)::double precision) + COALESCE(wd."Total Walmart Funded Savings", (0)::double precision)) AS price_subtotal,
    tab_ol.product_cost_unit,
    tab_ol.upgrade_labor,
    tab_ol.removed_hardware,
    tab_ol.hardware_cost,
    tab_ol.brand,
    tab_ol.category,
    tab_ol.category_id,
    tab_ol.category_parent_left,
    tab_ol.category_parent_right,
    tab_ol.bundle_sku_id,
    tab_ol.bundle_sku_line_id,
    tab_ol.is_distribution
   FROM (((((((ba_order_line_info tab_ol
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cwzy_amazon_promotion.sale_order_line_id,
            sum(cwzy_amazon_promotion.item_promotion_discount) AS promotion
           FROM cwzy_amazon_promotion
          GROUP BY cwzy_amazon_promotion.sale_order_line_id) tab_prom ON ((tab_prom.sale_order_line_id = tab_ol.order_line_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ba_order_line_shipping_cost_organized sco ON ((sco.sale_order_line_id = tab_ol.order_line_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cwzy_bundle_sku_lines cbsl ON ((tab_ol.bundle_sku_line_id = cbsl.id)))
     LEFT JOIN walmart_data wd ON ((((wd.order_id)::text = (tab_ol.order_name)::text) AND ((wd.sku)::text = (tab_ol.sku)::text) AND ((cbsl.is_primary_product IS TRUE) OR (cbsl.id IS NULL)))))
     LEFT JOIN newegg_data nd ON ((((nd.order_id)::text = (tab_ol.order_name)::text) AND ((nd.sku)::text = (tab_ol.sku)::text))))
     LEFT JOIN sub_product sp ON ((((sp.order_name)::text = (tab_ol.order_name)::text) AND ((sp.sku)::text = (tab_ol.sku)::text))))
     LEFT JOIN ba_store_commission bsc ON (((bsc.store = tab_ol.store) AND ((tab_ol.store <> ALL (ARRAY['PCOnline US_NE'::text, 'PCOnline US_NEB'::text])) OR ((tab_ol.store = ANY (ARRAY['PCOnline US_NE'::text, 'PCOnline US_NEB'::text])) AND ((tab_ol.date_order)::date >= COALESCE(bsc.start_date, '1900-01-01'::date)) AND ((tab_ol.date_order)::date <= COALESCE(bsc.end_date, '2999-12-31'::date)))))));

SELECT COALESCE(sale.date_order, purchase.date_received) AS date,

            COALESCE(main_pp.default_code, pp.default_code) AS main_ir,

             LEFT JOIN sale_order so ON ((sol.order_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_product pp ON ((sol.product_id = pp.id)))

          GROUP BY (to_char(timezone('US/Eastern'::text, (sm.date)::timestamp with time zone), 'yyyy-mm-dd'::text)), COALESCE(main_pp.default_code, pp.default_code)) purchase ON (((sale.date_order = purchase.date_received) AND ((sale.main_ir)::text = (purchase.main_ir)::text))));

SELECT sc.tracking_id,

            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'::text) THEN to_date(substr((sc.invoice_date)::text, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text)
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~* '^\d{1,2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{4}$'::text) THEN to_date(initcap((sc.invoice_date)::text), 'DD-Mon-YYYY'::text)

                  GROUP BY shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments.tracking_id) sa ON (((sb.tracking_id)::text = (sa.tracking_id)::text)))) sc
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sale_order_package.tracking_id,

  WHERE ((sc.tracking_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((sc.tracking_id)::text <> ''::text) AND (sop.tracking_id IS NULL) AND (((
        CASE
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~ '^\d{8}$'::text) THEN to_date((sc.invoice_date)::text, 'YYYYMMDD'::text)
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'::text) THEN to_date(substr((sc.invoice_date)::text, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text)
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~* '^\d{1,2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{4}$'::text) THEN to_date(initcap((sc.invoice_date)::text), 'DD-Mon-YYYY'::text)
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~ '^\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}'::text) THEN to_date(split_part(replace((sc.invoice_date)::text, '/'::text, '-'::text), ' '::text, 1), 'MM-DD-YYYY'::text)
            ELSE NULL::date
        END >= (date_trunc('year'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'US/Eastern'::text)) - '1 year'::interval)) AND (
        CASE
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~ '^\d{8}$'::text) THEN to_date((sc.invoice_date)::text, 'YYYYMMDD'::text)
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'::text) THEN to_date(substr((sc.invoice_date)::text, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text)
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~* '^\d{1,2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{4}$'::text) THEN to_date(initcap((sc.invoice_date)::text), 'DD-Mon-YYYY'::text)
            WHEN ((sc.invoice_date)::text ~ '^\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}'::text) THEN to_date(split_part(replace((sc.invoice_date)::text, '/'::text, '-'::text), ' '::text, 1), 'MM-DD-YYYY'::text)
            ELSE NULL::date

        CASE

WITH latest_lot AS (
         SELECT spl.id AS lot_id,
            spl.name AS sn
           FROM ( SELECT stock_production_lot.id,

                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY stock_production_lot.name ORDER BY stock_production_lot.create_date DESC, stock_production_lot.id DESC) AS rn
                   FROM stock_production_lot) spl
          WHERE (spl.rn = 1)
        ), warra_sn AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT sml.product_id,
            sml.location_id,
            sml.location_dest_id,
            s.sn
           FROM (latest_lot s
             LEFT JOIN stock_move_line sml ON ((s.lot_id = sml.lot_id)))
          WHERE (sml.location_dest_id = 64)
        ), warra_sn_count AS (
         SELECT warra_sn.product_id,
            count(DISTINCT warra_sn.sn) AS distinct_sn_number,
            count(*) AS sn_number
           FROM warra_sn
          GROUP BY warra_sn.product_id
        ), de_onhand_count AS (
         SELECT sq.product_id,
            sum(sq.quantity) AS de_count
           FROM (stock_quant sq
             LEFT JOIN product_product pp_1 ON ((pp_1.id = sq.product_id)))
          WHERE (sq.location_id = 15)
          GROUP BY sq.product_id
        ), returnable_sn_count AS (
         SELECT unnamed_subquery.product_id,
            count(DISTINCT unnamed_subquery.sn) AS distinct_returnable_sn_count
           FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT sml.product_id,
                    s.name AS sn
                   FROM (stock_production_lot s
                     LEFT JOIN stock_move_line sml ON ((s.id = sml.lot_id)))
                  WHERE ((sml.location_dest_id = ANY (ARRAY[64, 55, 122, 15, 22, 104, 128])) OR ((sml.location_id = ANY (ARRAY[64, 55, 122, 15, 22, 104, 128])) AND (sml.location_dest_id = 9)))) unnamed_subquery
          GROUP BY unnamed_subquery.product_id
        )
 SELECT pc.name AS category,

    pp.default_code AS ir,
    COALESCE(ppm.barcode, pp.barcode) AS origin_barcode,
    pp.barcode,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(wsc.distinct_sn_number, (0)::bigint), (0)::bigint) AS distinct_sn_number,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(wsc.sn_number, (0)::bigint), (0)::bigint) AS sn_number,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(rsc.distinct_returnable_sn_count, (0)::bigint), (0)::bigint) AS distinct_returnable_sn_count,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(de.de_count, (0)::double precision), (0)::double precision) AS deonhand_count
   FROM (((((((warra_sn_count wsc
     FULL JOIN returnable_sn_count rsc ON ((rsc.product_id = wsc.product_id)))
     FULL JOIN de_onhand_count de ON ((de.product_id = COALESCE(wsc.product_id, rsc.product_id))))
     LEFT JOIN product_product pp ON ((pp.id = COALESCE(wsc.product_id, rsc.product_id, de.product_id))))
     LEFT JOIN product_product ppm ON ((pp.main_product_id = ppm.id)))
     LEFT JOIN product_template pt ON ((pp.product_tmpl_id = pt.id)))
     LEFT JOIN product_brand pb ON ((pt.product_brand_id = pb.id)))
     LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON ((pt.categ_id = pc.id)))
  ORDER BY pp.default_code;

WITH sn_lot AS (
         SELECT t.id AS lot_id,
            t.sn,
            t.product_id,
            ((COALESCE(t.origin_cost_unit, (0)::double precision) + COALESCE(t.install_hardware, (0)::double precision)) - COALESCE(t.remove_hardware, (0)::double precision)) AS cost
           FROM ( SELECT stock_production_lot.id,
                    stock_production_lot.name AS sn,
                    stock_production_lot.origin_cost_unit,
                    stock_production_lot.install_hardware,
                    stock_production_lot.remove_hardware,
                    stock_production_lot.product_id,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY stock_production_lot.name ORDER BY stock_production_lot.create_date DESC, stock_production_lot.id DESC) AS rn
                   FROM stock_production_lot) t
          WHERE (t.rn = 1)
        ), warra_sn AS (
         SELECT sl.lot_id,
            sl.sn,
            sl.product_id,
            sl.cost
           FROM (( SELECT stock_quant.lot_id,
                    stock_quant.location_id,
                    stock_quant.quantity
                   FROM stock_quant) sq
             LEFT JOIN sn_lot sl ON ((sl.lot_id = sq.lot_id)))
          WHERE ((sq.lot_id IS NOT NULL) AND (sq.location_id = 64) AND (sq.quantity > (0)::double precision) AND (sl.sn IS NOT NULL))
        ), latest_move AS (
         SELECT t.lot_id,
            t.move_id,
            t.date,
            (CURRENT_DATE - date(t.date)) AS in_warra_time,
            t.product_id,
            t.location_dest_id,
            t.write_uid
           FROM ( SELECT stock_move_line.lot_id,
                    stock_move_line.move_id,
                    stock_move_line.date,
                    stock_move_line.product_id,
                    stock_move_line.location_dest_id,
                    stock_move_line.write_uid,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY stock_move_line.lot_id ORDER BY stock_move_line.date DESC, stock_move_line.move_id DESC) AS rn
                   FROM stock_move_line) t
          WHERE ((t.rn = 1) AND (t.location_dest_id = 64))
        ), rd AS (
         SELECT rr.name,
            ru.id,
            ru.partner_id
           FROM ((hr_employee hr
             LEFT JOIN resource_resource rr ON ((rr.id = hr.resource_id)))
             LEFT JOIN res_users ru ON ((ru.id = rr.user_id)))
        ), attribute_value AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT al.product_tmpl_id,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((pa.name)::text = 'CPU Series'::text) THEN a.attribute_values
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS cpu_series,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((pa.name)::text = 'GPU Series'::text) THEN a.attribute_values
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS gpu_series
           FROM ((( SELECT rel.product_attribute_line_id,
                    count(*) AS count,
                    string_agg((
                        CASE
                            WHEN ("right"((pav.name)::text, 2) = ' S'::text) THEN (TRIM(TRAILING ' S'::text FROM pav.name))::character varying
                            ELSE pav.name
                        END)::text, '，'::text) AS attribute_values
                   FROM (product_attribute_line_product_attribute_value_rel rel
                     LEFT JOIN product_attribute_value pav ON ((pav.id = rel.product_attribute_value_id)))
                  GROUP BY rel.product_attribute_line_id
                 HAVING (count(*) >= 1)) a
             LEFT JOIN product_attribute_line al ON ((al.id = a.product_attribute_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_attribute pa ON ((pa.id = al.attribute_id)))
          WHERE ((pa.name)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['GPU Series'::character varying, 'CPU Series'::character varying])::text[]))
          GROUP BY al.product_tmpl_id
        )
 SELECT ws.sn,
    pb.name AS brand,

    pp.barcode,

WITH vars AS (
         SELECT 64 AS location_id
        ), stock AS (
         SELECT sq.product_id,
            sum(sq.quantity) AS current_onhand
           FROM stock_quant sq,
            vars
          WHERE (sq.location_id = vars.location_id)
          GROUP BY sq.product_id
        ), move_week AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('week'::text, timezone('US/Eastern'::text, (sm.date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))) AS week,
            sm.product_id,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (sm.location_dest_id = vars.location_id) THEN sm.product_qty
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS movein,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (sm.location_id = vars.location_id) THEN sm.product_qty
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS moveout
           FROM stock_move sm,
            vars
          WHERE (((sm.state)::text = 'done'::text) AND ((sm.location_dest_id = vars.location_id) OR (sm.location_id = vars.location_id)))
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('week'::text, timezone('US/Eastern'::text, (sm.date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)))), sm.product_id
        ), week_net AS (
         SELECT move_week.week,
            move_week.product_id,
            COALESCE(move_week.movein, (0)::numeric) AS movein,
            COALESCE(move_week.moveout, (0)::numeric) AS moveout,
            (COALESCE(move_week.movein, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(move_week.moveout, (0)::numeric)) AS net_change
           FROM move_week
        ), big AS (
         SELECT wn.week,
            wn.product_id,
            COALESCE(s.current_onhand, (0)::double precision) AS current_onhand,
            wn.movein,
            wn.moveout,
            (COALESCE(s.current_onhand, (0)::double precision) - (COALESCE(sum(wn.net_change) OVER (PARTITION BY wn.product_id ORDER BY wn.week DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), (0)::numeric))::double precision) AS onhand_end_of_week
           FROM (week_net wn
             LEFT JOIN stock s ON ((s.product_id = wn.product_id)))
        )
 SELECT big.week,
    pp.default_code AS ir,
    big.movein,
    big.moveout,
    big.onhand_end_of_week AS stock,
    COALESCE((bpii.cost * big.onhand_end_of_week), (0)::double precision) AS t_value,
    pb.name AS brand,
    pc.name AS category,
    COALESCE(main_pp.default_code, pp.default_code) AS origin_ir,
    pp.barcode AS upc,
    COALESCE(main_pp.barcode, pp.barcode) AS origin_upc
   FROM ((((((big
     LEFT JOIN product_product pp ON ((pp.id = big.product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN product_product main_pp ON ((pp.main_product_id = main_pp.id)))
     LEFT JOIN bi_pm_ir_info bpii ON (((bpii.ir)::text = (pp.default_code)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN product_template pt ON ((pp.product_tmpl_id = pt.id)))
     LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON ((pt.categ_id = pc.id)))
     LEFT JOIN product_brand pb ON ((pt.product_brand_id = pb.id)));

WITH productid_ir AS (
         SELECT pt.id AS product_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pp.main_product_id IS NULL) THEN pt.default_code
                    WHEN (pp.main_product_id IS NOT NULL) THEN pt2.default_code
                    ELSE NULL::character varying
                END AS main_ir,
            pt.default_code AS ir
           FROM (((product_product pp
             LEFT JOIN product_template pt ON ((pp.product_tmpl_id = pt.id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_product pp2 ON ((pp.main_product_id = pp2.id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_template pt2 ON ((pp2.product_tmpl_id = pt2.id)))
          WHERE ((pp.active IS TRUE) AND (pt.active IS TRUE))
        ), amazon_sku AS (
         SELECT apa.name AS asin,
            aps.name AS sku,
            aps.product_id,
            'Amazon'::text AS marketplace,
                CASE
                    WHEN (aps.instance_id = 2) THEN 'renew'::text
                    ELSE 'new'::text
                END AS condition
           FROM (amazon_product_sku aps
             LEFT JOIN amazon_product_asin apa ON ((aps.product_asin_id = apa.id)))
          WHERE (aps.active IS TRUE)
        ), walmart_sku AS (
         SELECT NULL::character varying AS asin,
            walmart_sku.name AS sku,
            walmart_sku.product_id,
            'Walmart'::text AS marketplace,
            COALESCE((walmart_sku.condition)::text, 'new'::text) AS condition
           FROM public.walmart_sku
        ), newegg_sku AS (
         SELECT NULL::character varying AS asin,
            ns.name AS sku,
            ns.product_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((ns.name)::text ~~ like_escape('%\_NB%'::text, '\'::text)) THEN 'Neweggbusiness'::text
                    ELSE 'Newegg'::text
                END AS marketplace,
            COALESCE((ns.condition)::text, 'new'::text) AS condition
           FROM public.newegg_sku ns
        ), other_sku AS (
         SELECT NULL::character varying AS asin,
            a.sku,
            a.product_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 21) THEN 'Macys'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 2) THEN 'Macys'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 8) THEN 'Shein'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 9) THEN 'Target'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 11) THEN 'TikTok'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 15) THEN 'TikTok'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 12) THEN 'Temu'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 13) THEN 'Shein'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 16) THEN 'Temu'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 20) THEN 'Bestbuy'::text
                    WHEN (a.store_id = 17) THEN 'Ebay'::text
                    ELSE (b.name)::text
                END AS marketplace,
            COALESCE((a.condition)::text, 'new'::text) AS condition
           FROM (cwzy_shipstation_sku a
             LEFT JOIN cwzy_shipstation_store b ON ((a.store_id = b.id)))
          WHERE ((a.active IS TRUE) AND (b.active IS TRUE))
        ), all_sku AS (
         SELECT amazon_sku.asin,
            amazon_sku.sku,
            amazon_sku.product_id,
            amazon_sku.marketplace,
            amazon_sku.condition
           FROM amazon_sku
        UNION
         SELECT walmart_sku.asin,
            walmart_sku.sku,
            walmart_sku.product_id,
            walmart_sku.marketplace,
            walmart_sku.condition
           FROM walmart_sku
        UNION
         SELECT newegg_sku.asin,
            newegg_sku.sku,
            newegg_sku.product_id,
            newegg_sku.marketplace,
            newegg_sku.condition
           FROM newegg_sku
        UNION
         SELECT other_sku.asin,
            other_sku.sku,
            other_sku.product_id,
            other_sku.marketplace,
            other_sku.condition
           FROM other_sku
        ), all_but_bundle AS (
         SELECT a.sku,
            a.marketplace,
            a.condition,
            b.ir,
            b.main_ir AS origin_ir,
                CASE
                    WHEN (a.marketplace = 'Amazon'::text) THEN a.asin
                    ELSE NULL::character varying
                END AS asin,
            0 AS is_bundle_sku,
            true AS is_primary_product
           FROM ((all_sku a
             LEFT JOIN product_product pp ON ((a.product_id = pp.id)))
             LEFT JOIN productid_ir b ON ((pp.product_tmpl_id = b.product_id)))
          WHERE (pp.active IS TRUE)
        ), bundle AS (
         SELECT cbs.name AS sku,
                CASE
                    WHEN (((cbs.source)::text = 'shipstation'::text) AND (cbs.cwzy_store_id IS NOT NULL)) THEN (
                    CASE
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 21) THEN 'Macys'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 2) THEN 'Macys'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 8) THEN 'Shein'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 9) THEN 'Target'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 11) THEN 'TikTok'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 15) THEN 'TikTok'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 12) THEN 'Temu'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 13) THEN 'Shein'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 16) THEN 'Temu'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 20) THEN 'Bestbuy'::text
                        WHEN (cbs.cwzy_store_id = 17) THEN 'Ebay'::text
                        ELSE 'Other'::text
                    END)::character varying
                    WHEN ((cbs.source)::text = 'amazon'::text) THEN 'Amazon'::character varying
                    WHEN ((cbs.source)::text = 'walmart'::text) THEN 'Walmart'::character varying
                    WHEN ((cbs.source)::text = 'newegg'::text) THEN 'Newegg'::character varying
                    ELSE cbs.source
                END AS marketplace,
            'new'::text AS condition,
            cbsl.default_code AS ir,
            COALESCE(mpp.default_code, pp.default_code) AS main_ir,
            apa.name AS asin,
            1 AS is_bundle_sku,
            cbsl.is_primary_product
           FROM ((((cwzy_bundle_sku_lines cbsl
