WITH tab AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT al.product_tmpl_id,
            pa.name AS attribute_name,
            a.attrubute_values
           FROM ((( SELECT rel.product_attribute_line_id,
                    count(*) AS count,
                    string_agg((
                        CASE
                            WHEN ("right"((pav.name)::text, 2) = ' S'::text) THEN (TRIM(TRAILING ' S'::text FROM pav.name))::character varying
                            ELSE pav.name
                        END)::text, '，'::text) AS attrubute_values
                   FROM (product_attribute_line_product_attribute_value_rel rel
                     LEFT JOIN product_attribute_value pav ON ((pav.id = rel.product_attribute_value_id)))
                  GROUP BY rel.product_attribute_line_id
                 HAVING (count(*) >= 1)) a
             LEFT JOIN product_attribute_line al ON ((al.id = a.product_attribute_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN product_attribute pa ON ((pa.id = al.attribute_id)))
          WHERE ((pa.name)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RAM Capacity'::character varying, 'Storage1'::character varying, 'Storage2'::character varying, 'Operating System'::character varying])::text[]))
        ), market_sales AS (
         SELECT ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.ir,
            ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.main_ir,
                CASE
                    WHEN (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.market_place = ANY (ARRAY['Amazon'::text, 'Amazon CA'::text])) THEN 'Amazon'::text
                    ELSE ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.market_place
                END AS unified_market_place,
            sum(ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.units) AS total_units
           FROM ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info
          WHERE ((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.type = 'order'::text) AND (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.date_order >= (date_trunc('week'::text, ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'::text)) - '8 days'::interval)) AND (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.date_order < (date_trunc('week'::text, ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'::text)) - '1 day'::interval)))
          GROUP BY ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.market_place, ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.ir, ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.main_ir
        )
 SELECT ms.ir,
    string_agg(
        CASE
            WHEN (((tab.attribute_name)::text = 'RAM Capacity'::text) AND (tab.attrubute_values IS NOT NULL) AND (tab.attrubute_values <> ''::text)) THEN regexp_replace(tab.attrubute_values, '[^\d]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text)
            WHEN (((tab.attribute_name)::text = 'Storage1'::text) AND (tab.attrubute_values IS NOT NULL) AND (tab.attrubute_values <> ''::text)) THEN "substring"(tab.attrubute_values, '(\d+)(?=\s*GB|\s*TB)'::text)
            WHEN (((tab.attribute_name)::text = 'Storage2'::text) AND (tab.attrubute_values IS NOT NULL) AND (tab.attrubute_values <> ''::text)) THEN "substring"(tab.attrubute_values, '(\d+)(?=\s*GB|\s*TB)'::text)
            WHEN (((tab.attribute_name)::text = 'Operating System'::text) AND (tab.attrubute_values IS NOT NULL) AND (tab.attrubute_values <> ''::text)) THEN regexp_replace(tab.attrubute_values, '.*(Home|Pro).*'::text, '\1'::text, 'i'::text)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END, '-'::text ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN ((tab.attribute_name)::text = 'RAM Capacity'::text) THEN 1
            WHEN ((tab.attribute_name)::text = 'Storage1'::text) THEN 2
            WHEN ((tab.attribute_name)::text = 'Storage2'::text) THEN 3
            WHEN ((tab.attribute_name)::text = 'Operating System'::text) THEN 4
            ELSE 4
        END) AS configurations,
    ms.main_ir,
    ms.unified_market_place AS market_place,
    ms.total_units AS units
   FROM ((market_sales ms
     LEFT JOIN product_template pt ON (((pt.default_code)::text = (ms.ir)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN tab ON ((tab.product_tmpl_id = pt.id)))
  WHERE ((ms.main_ir)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['82LX005TUS'::character varying, '83DG00EFUS'::character varying, '90SM00C5US-DT'::character varying])::text[]))
  GROUP BY ms.unified_market_place, ms.ir, ms.main_ir, ms.total_units
  ORDER BY ms.unified_market_place, ms.ir;

WITH real_shipping AS (
         SELECT x.order_id,
            sum(x.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee
           FROM ( SELECT (sop.order_id)::text AS order_id,
                    sum(sc.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee
                   FROM (( SELECT sif.express_or_ground_tracking_id AS tracking_id,
                            sum(sif.net_charge_amount) AS shipping_fee
                           FROM datas.shipping_invoice_fedex sif
                          GROUP BY sif.express_or_ground_tracking_id
                        UNION ALL
                         SELECT siu.track_num AS tracking_id,
                            sum(siu.tot_net) AS shipping_fee
                           FROM datas.shipping_invoice_ups siu
                          WHERE ((siu.service_text)::text <> 'PAYMENT PROCESSING FEE'::text)
                          GROUP BY siu.track_num
                        UNION ALL
                         SELECT sb.tracking_id,
                            (COALESCE(sb.shipping, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(sa.adjustment_shipping, (0)::numeric)) AS shipping_fee
                           FROM (( SELECT shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping.tracking_id,
                                    sum((shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping.tax_inclusive_total_charge_usd)::numeric) AS shipping
                                   FROM datas.shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping
                                  GROUP BY shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping.tracking_id) sb
                             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments.tracking_id,
                                    sum((shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments.base_rate_incl_tax_usd)::numeric) AS adjustment_shipping
                                   FROM datas.shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments
                                  GROUP BY shipping_invoice_amazon_shipping_adjustments.tracking_id) sa ON (((sb.tracking_id)::text = (sa.tracking_id)::text)))) sc
                     LEFT JOIN sale_order_package sop ON (((sc.tracking_id)::text = (sop.tracking_id)::text)))
                  WHERE (sop.order_id IS NOT NULL)
                  GROUP BY (sop.order_id)::text
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT (so.id)::text AS order_id,
                    abs(sum((sri.other_amount)::numeric)) AS shipping_fee
                   FROM (settlement_report_info sri
                     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sale_order.id,
                            sale_order.name
                           FROM sale_order) so ON (((so.name)::text = (sri.order_id)::text)))
                  WHERE ((sri.transaction_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY['Shipping label purchase'::text, 'ShippingServicesRefund'::text]))
                  GROUP BY (so.id)::text
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT (so.id)::text AS order_id,
                    sum(abs((t.total)::numeric)) AS shipping_fee
                   FROM (datas.shipping_invoice_temu t
                     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sale_order.id,
                            sale_order.name
                           FROM sale_order) so ON (((so.name)::text = (t.order_id)::text)))
                  WHERE ((t.transaction_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY['Shipping label for return purchase'::text, 'Shipping label for return purchase adjustment'::text, 'Shipping label purchase'::text, 'Shipping label purchase adjustment'::text]))
                  GROUP BY (so.id)::text) x
          GROUP BY x.order_id
        ), estimate_shipping AS (
         SELECT (sop.order_id)::text AS order_id,
            (sum(abs(sop.estimate_shipping_fee)))::numeric AS shipping_fee
           FROM sale_order_package sop
          WHERE (sop.estimate_shipping_fee IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY (sop.order_id)::text
        ), order_shipping AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(so.id, r.order_id, e.order_id) AS order_id,
            COALESCE(r.shipping_fee, e.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee
           FROM ((( SELECT (sale_order.id)::text AS id
                   FROM sale_order) so
             LEFT JOIN real_shipping r ON ((r.order_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN estimate_shipping e ON ((so.id = e.order_id)))
        ), all_shipping_fee AS (
         SELECT sol.id AS sale_order_line_id,
            sol.product_uom_qty AS order_line_unit,
            ((sol.per_unit_fulfillment_fee * (sol.product_uom_qty)::double precision))::numeric AS order_line_total_shipping_fee,
            so.id AS order_id,
            so.name AS order_name,
            so.order_unit,
            NULL::numeric AS order_total_shipping_fee,
            so.date_order AS order_date,
            sol.product_id,
            sol.sku,
            sol.bundle_sku_id,
            sol.bundle_sku_line_id
           FROM (sale_order_line sol
             JOIN sale_order so ON ((sol.order_id = so.id)))
          WHERE ((so.amz_fulfillment_by)::text = 'AFN'::text)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT sol.id AS sale_order_line_id,
            sol.product_uom_qty AS order_line_unit,
            ((((abs(os.shipping_fee))::double precision / NULLIF(so.order_unit, (0)::double precision)) * (sol.product_uom_qty)::double precision))::numeric AS order_line_total_shipping_fee,
            so.id AS order_id,
            so.name AS order_name,
            so.order_unit,
            abs(os.shipping_fee) AS order_total_shipping_fee,
            so.date_order AS order_date,
            sol.product_id,
            sol.sku,
            sol.bundle_sku_id,
            sol.bundle_sku_line_id
           FROM ((order_shipping os
             JOIN sale_order so ON (((so.id)::text = os.order_id)))
             JOIN sale_order_line sol ON ((sol.order_id = so.id)))
          WHERE (NOT ((so.amz_fulfillment_by)::text = 'AFN'::text))
        ), walmart_data AS (
         SELECT cwzy_walmart_recon_info.purchase_order AS order_name,
            cwzy_walmart_recon_info.partner_item_id AS sku,
            abs(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((cwzy_walmart_recon_info.transaction_description)::text = 'WFS Fulfillment fee'::text) THEN (cwzy_walmart_recon_info.amount)::double precision
                    ELSE (0)::double precision
                END)) AS "WFS Fulfillment fee"
           FROM cwzy_walmart_recon_info
          GROUP BY cwzy_walmart_recon_info.purchase_order, cwzy_walmart_recon_info.partner_item_id
        ), shipping_fee_adjust AS (
         SELECT asf.order_id,
            asf.order_name,
            asf.sale_order_line_id,
            asf.sku,
            pp.default_code AS ir,
            cbsl.is_primary_product AS is_primary,
            (((sum(COALESCE(asf.order_line_total_shipping_fee, (0)::numeric)))::double precision + sum(COALESCE(wd."WFS Fulfillment fee", (0)::double precision))))::numeric AS shipping_fee
           FROM (((all_shipping_fee asf
             LEFT JOIN cwzy_bundle_sku_lines cbsl ON ((asf.bundle_sku_line_id = cbsl.id)))
             LEFT JOIN walmart_data wd ON ((((wd.order_name)::text = (asf.order_name)::text) AND ((wd.sku)::text = (asf.sku)::text) AND ((cbsl.is_primary_product IS TRUE) OR (cbsl.id IS NULL)))))
             LEFT JOIN product_product pp ON ((pp.id = asf.product_id)))
          GROUP BY asf.order_id, asf.order_name, asf.sale_order_line_id, asf.sku, pp.default_code, cbsl.is_primary_product
        ), primary_row AS (
         SELECT shipping_fee_adjust.order_id,
            max((
                CASE
                    WHEN (shipping_fee_adjust.is_primary IS TRUE) THEN shipping_fee_adjust.ir
                    ELSE NULL::character varying
                END)::text) AS primary_ir,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (shipping_fee_adjust.is_primary IS TRUE) THEN shipping_fee_adjust.sale_order_line_id
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END) AS primary_sale_order_line_id
           FROM shipping_fee_adjust
          WHERE (shipping_fee_adjust.is_primary IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY shipping_fee_adjust.order_id
        ), correct_shipping_fee AS (
         SELECT wa.order_id,
            wa.sale_order_line_id,
            wa.sku,
            wa.ir,
            (- wa.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee
           FROM shipping_fee_adjust wa
          WHERE (wa.is_primary IS FALSE)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT wa.order_id,
            pr.primary_sale_order_line_id AS sale_order_line_id,
            wa.sku,
            pr.primary_ir AS ir,
            wa.shipping_fee
           FROM (shipping_fee_adjust wa
             JOIN primary_row pr ON ((pr.order_id = wa.order_id)))
          WHERE (wa.is_primary IS FALSE)
        ), final_shipping_fee AS (
         SELECT a.order_id,
            a.sale_order_line_id,
            a.sku,
            a.ir,
            sum(a.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee
           FROM ( SELECT shipping_fee_adjust.order_id,
                    shipping_fee_adjust.sale_order_line_id,
                    shipping_fee_adjust.sku,
                    shipping_fee_adjust.ir,
                    shipping_fee_adjust.shipping_fee
                   FROM shipping_fee_adjust
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT correct_shipping_fee.order_id,
                    correct_shipping_fee.sale_order_line_id,
                    correct_shipping_fee.sku,
                    correct_shipping_fee.ir,
                    correct_shipping_fee.shipping_fee
                   FROM correct_shipping_fee) a
          GROUP BY a.order_id, a.sale_order_line_id, a.sku, a.ir
        )
 SELECT order_id,
    sale_order_line_id,
    shipping_fee
   FROM final_shipping_fee;

WITH sp_ir AS (
         SELECT sp.date,

            sum(sp.purchases7d) AS "order",

           FROM (datas.sp_advertised_product_reports sp
             LEFT JOIN bi_pm_amazon_sku_ir_mapping map ON ((sp."advertisedSku" = (map.sku)::text)))
          GROUP BY sp.date, map.origin_ir
        ), subtotal_data AS (
         SELECT date((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.date_order - '03:00:00'::interval)) AS date_order,
            ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.main_ir,
            sum(ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.price_subtotal) AS ttl_sales
           FROM ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info
          WHERE ((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.type = 'order'::text) AND (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.market_place = 'Amazon'::text) AND (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.account_type = 'New'::text) AND (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.has_product_cost = true) AND (ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.has_sale_price = true) AND ((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.category)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['BOM'::character varying, 'Used'::character varying, 'New'::character varying, 'Services'::character varying, 'Computer Accessories'::character varying, 'Warranty'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.main_ir)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['SHIPPING FEE'::character varying, 'SHIPMENT DISCOUNT'::character varying, 'GIFT WRAPPER FEE'::character varying, 'PROMOTION DISCOUNT'::character varying])::text[])))
          GROUP BY (date((ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.date_order - '03:00:00'::interval))), ba_mv_profit_order_line_and_ad_info.main_ir
        ), all_data AS (
         SELECT s.date,
            EXTRACT(year FROM ((s.date - ('1 day'::interval * ((EXTRACT(dow FROM s.date))::integer)::double precision)) + '1 day'::interval)) AS year,
            EXTRACT(week FROM ((s.date - ('1 day'::interval * ((EXTRACT(dow FROM s.date))::integer)::double precision)) + '1 day'::interval)) AS weeknum,
            s.origin_ir AS main_ir,
            dmmap.dm_follower AS dm,
            sum(s.imp) AS imp,
            sum(s.click) AS click,
            sum(s.spend) AS spend,
            sum(s."order") AS "order",
            sum(s.sales) AS sales,
            sum(COALESCE(sd.ttl_sales, (0)::double precision)) AS ttl_sales
           FROM ((( SELECT sp_ir.date,
                    sp_ir.origin_ir,
                    sp_ir.imp,
                    sp_ir.click,
                    sp_ir.spend,
                    sp_ir."order",
                    sp_ir.sales
                   FROM sp_ir
                  WHERE (sp_ir.imp > 0)) s
             LEFT JOIN subtotal_data sd ON ((((s.origin_ir)::text = (sd.main_ir)::text) AND (s.date = sd.date_order))))
             LEFT JOIN ba_main_product_info dmmap ON (((s.origin_ir)::text = (dmmap.ir)::text)))
          GROUP BY s.date, (EXTRACT(year FROM ((s.date - ('1 day'::interval * ((EXTRACT(dow FROM s.date))::integer)::double precision)) + '1 day'::interval))), (EXTRACT(week FROM ((s.date - ('1 day'::interval * ((EXTRACT(dow FROM s.date))::integer)::double precision)) + '1 day'::interval))), s.origin_ir, dmmap.dm_follower
        )
 SELECT year,

    main_ir,
    dm,
    sum(imp) AS imp,
    sum(click) AS click,
    sum(spend) AS spend,
    sum("order") AS "order",
    sum(sales) AS ads_sales,
    sum(COALESCE(ttl_sales, (0)::double precision)) AS ttl_sales,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(click) = (0)::numeric) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (sum(spend) / sum(click))
        END AS cpc,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(imp) = (0)::numeric) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (sum(click) / sum(imp))
        END AS ctr,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(click) = (0)::numeric) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (sum("order") / sum(click))
        END AS cvr,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(sales) = (0)::numeric) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (sum(spend) / sum(sales))
        END AS acos,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum("order") = (0)::numeric) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (sum(sales) / sum("order"))
        END AS bs,
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(ttl_sales) = (0)::double precision) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (sum(spend) / (sum(ttl_sales))::numeric)
        END AS tacos
   FROM all_data ad
  GROUP BY year, weeknum, main_ir, dm
  ORDER BY year DESC, weeknum DESC;

WITH const AS (

        ), outbound AS (

SELECT abu.budget_scope_id AS campaign_id,
    sp_campaign_reports."campaignName" AS campaign_name,
    str.portfolio_id,
    pin.portfolio_name,
    pin.product_line,
    abu.budget,
    abu.budget_usage_percentage,
    abu.pdt_timestamp,
    abu.edt_timestamp,
    stc.clicks,
    stc.sales_1d,
    stc.conversions_1d,
    LEAST(round((stc."ACOS")::numeric, 4), (9999)::numeric) AS "ACOS"
   FROM ((((( SELECT ads_budget_usage.budget_scope_id,
            ads_budget_usage.budget,
            ads_budget_usage.budget_usage_percentage,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ads_budget_usage.budget_scope_id ORDER BY ads_budget_usage.usage_updated_timestamp DESC) AS _rn,
            timezone('UTC'::text, timezone('US/Pacific'::text, ads_budget_usage.usage_updated_timestamp)) AS pdt_timestamp,
            timezone('UTC'::text, timezone('US/Eastern'::text, ads_budget_usage.usage_updated_timestamp)) AS edt_timestamp
           FROM datas.ads_budget_usage) abu
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sp_campaign_reports_1."campaignName",
            sp_campaign_reports_1."campaignId"
           FROM ( SELECT sp_campaign_reports_1_1."campaignName",
                    sp_campaign_reports_1_1."campaignId",
                    max(sp_campaign_reports_1_1.date) AS date,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sp_campaign_reports_1_1."campaignId" ORDER BY (max(sp_campaign_reports_1_1.date)) DESC) AS _rn
                   FROM datas.sp_campaign_reports sp_campaign_reports_1_1
                  GROUP BY sp_campaign_reports_1_1."campaignId", sp_campaign_reports_1_1."campaignName"
                  ORDER BY (max(sp_campaign_reports_1_1.date))) sp_campaign_reports_1
          WHERE (sp_campaign_reports_1._rn = 1)) sp_campaign_reports ON ((abu.budget_scope_id = sp_campaign_reports."campaignId")))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT min(sp_targeting_reports."portfolioId") AS portfolio_id,
            sp_targeting_reports."campaignId"
           FROM datas.sp_targeting_reports
          GROUP BY sp_targeting_reports."campaignId") str ON ((abu.budget_scope_id = str."campaignId")))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sum(ad_info_summary.clicks) AS clicks,
            ad_info_summary.campaign_id,
            sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_sales_1d) AS sales_1d,
            sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_conversions_1d) AS conversions_1d,
            (sum(ad_info_summary.cost) / NULLIF(sum(ad_info_summary.attributed_sales_1d), (0)::double precision)) AS "ACOS"
           FROM ad_info_summary
          WHERE (ad_info_summary.pdt_timestamp >= date_trunc('day'::text, timezone('UTC'::text, timezone('US/Pacific'::text, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))))
          GROUP BY ad_info_summary.campaign_id) stc ON ((abu.budget_scope_id = stc.campaign_id)))
     LEFT JOIN datas.portfolio_id_name pin ON ((pin.portfolio_id = str.portfolio_id)))
  WHERE ((abu._rn = 1) AND (abu.pdt_timestamp >= date_trunc('day'::text, timezone('UTC'::text, timezone('US/Pacific'::text, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))));
